correctness.rationale: Cone isometry and independently computed three-dimensional chord give an exact two-variable rational ratio. Independent area samples yield U=log(s/t) with density exp(-2|u|) and delta uniform on [0,pi]. Threshold conditioning integrates exactly. Monotonicity of x cot x proves unique distortion maximum, and a positive linear/quadratic local expansion plus dominated convergence proves the 3/2 endpoint exponent and coefficient. A fresh standard-library standalone test passed six numerical CDF comparisons and three limiting checks; computations are supplementary, not substitutes for analytic proof.

value.rationale: Metric distortion is the natural multiplicative cost of restricting Euclidean travel to the cone sidewall. The exact scale-free law gives all pairwise stochastic stretch levels, sharp worst-case ratio and its inverse shape invariant, and a 3/2-power rare-stretch law with explicit conditional geometry. These are natural, quantitative geometric facts not supplied by classical cone development or separately known intrinsic marginal statistics.
